Enterprise Architectural Pillars

Cookieless Hash Anonymization

Unique visitors are recognized through a SHA-256 rotating daily salt hashing IP and User-Agent. Zero persistent cookies, zero cross-site profiling, and full GDPR compliance without banner drop-offs.
